run_eval_script: run the eval.py script to evaluate a 3D object detection model on SUN RGB-D or ScanNet datasets
test_evaluate_one_epoch: test the evaluate_one_epoch function to compute mean loss and average precision metrics over a validation dataset
refactor_eval: refactor the eval function to support custom checkpoint paths, batch sizes, and NMS IoU thresholds via argparse
review_evaluate_one_epoch: review the evaluate_one_epoch function that iterates over a DataLoader, runs forward passes, computes loss, and calculates AP metrics
summarize_eval: summarize the eval function that initializes datasets, loads a VoteNet or BoxNet model checkpoint, and runs one epoch of evaluation
